title: Organon Typography Presets
description: Project-local typography preset registry. Lives at <projectPath>/.organon/typography-presets.json. Project entries override builtins on id collision; invalid entries are dropped at load time (never throw). Phase 25 (v1.2) — DR-8+ externalised registry.

id.description: Stable identifier. A project entry with the same id as a builtin overrides it.

pdfArgs.description: Argv elements appended to the pandoc PDF command.

docxArgs.description: Argv elements appended to the pandoc DOCX command.

css.description: v1.3 (Phase 30, DR-8++) — applies to HTML export only via Marp `--theme <tmp.css>`. PDF / DOCX continue to use pdfArgs / docxArgs verbatim because pandoc xelatex (--include-in-header) and pandoc DOCX (--reference-doc) target different artifacts; deferred to v1.4.
